name: Orchestral Gaming Soundtracks
description: Questions covering: Ori and the Blind Forest, Cuphead, Horizon Zero Dawn, Assassin's Creed II...

questions.question: Which British composer is responsible for the orchestral score of Ori and the Blind Forest?
questions.explanation_correct: Gareth Coker composed the critically acclaimed score for the title.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers listed are prominent British film or game composers but did not score this specific game.

questions.question: Which large jazz ensemble format features prominently in the 1930s-inspired Cuphead soundtrack?
questions.explanation_correct: Cuphead features big-band jazz arrangements drawing on early-20th-century styles, including swing.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Swing is also relevant to the score but is a style, whereas big band names the ensemble format.

questions.question: Which composer contributed to the tribal-orchestral score of Horizon Zero Dawn?
questions.explanation_correct: Joris de Man contributed to Horizon Zero Dawn alongside other composers and collaborators, including The Flight and Niels van der Leest.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The score was a collaborative production; the listed alternatives are not its named contributors.

questions.question: What is the title of the recurring orchestral family theme in Assassin's Creed II?
questions.explanation_correct: “Ezio’s Family” is a track from Assassin’s Creed II by Jesper Kyd; its musical ideas later returned in arrangements across the series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other titles are plausible but are not the official name of the specific recurring theme.

questions.question: What is the title of the piano-led piece heard near the beginning of Final Fantasy X?
questions.explanation_correct: “To Zanarkand” is a piano-led piece by Nobuo Uematsu heard near the beginning of Final Fantasy X.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other titles represent music or locations within the game but are not the specific opening track.

questions.question: Which composer wrote the track 'Leaving Earth' for Mass Effect 3?
questions.explanation_correct: Clint Mansell composed “Leaving Earth” for Mass Effect 3, one of several composers credited on the game.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others have contributed to the Mass Effect franchise but did not compose this specific track.

questions.question: Who composed the Dark Souls III tracks “Title Screen” and “Abyss Watchers”?
questions.explanation_correct: Yuka Kitamura is credited with these tracks; other composers, including Motoi Sakuraba, also contributed to the soundtrack.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Motoi Sakuraba is a veteran series composer, but Kitamura specifically handled these noted pieces.

questions.question: Who co-composed the soundtrack for Batman: Arkham City alongside Ron Fish?
questions.explanation_correct: Nick Arundel collaborated with Ron Fish to create the score for the second Arkham title.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The listed individuals are well-known game composers but were not the primary co-authors of this work.

questions.question: Who is credited as the composer for the main theme of Dragon Age: Inquisition?
questions.explanation_correct: Trevor Morris composed the main theme for Inquisition, shifting from the style of previous games.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Inon Zur composed for other Dragon Age titles and the others are common alternatives for fantasy RPG scoring.

questions.question: Which composer provided the unsettling orchestral score for BioShock?
questions.explanation_correct: Garry Schyman is renowned for his atmospheric and dissonant work on the BioShock franchise.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others are recognized for their work in different gaming genres or specific franchises.

questions.question: Who composed the specific orchestral theme for the character Kara in Detroit: Become Human?
questions.explanation_correct: Philip Sheppard composed the distinct, emotional score pieces for Kara's story arc.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others listed contributed to various other modern AAA game soundtracks.

questions.question: Which musician played shakuhachi before the Ghost of Tsushima presentation at E3 2018?
questions.explanation_correct: Cornelius Boots performed on shakuhachi before the Ghost of Tsushima presentation at Sony’s E3 2018 showcase.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Cornelius Boots performed at the E3 presentation; this question concerns the live performance, not the game’s soundtrack credits.

questions.question: Which composer for Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic is known for emulating the style of John Williams?
questions.explanation_correct: Jeremy Soule utilized orchestral techniques that mirrored the tone of the classic Star Wars films.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers have worked on Star Wars projects, but Soule handled the main KOTOR composition.

questions.question: Who is the composer of the main theme for Fallout 4?
questions.explanation_correct: Inon Zur composed the main theme and accompanying score for Fallout 4.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Mark Morgan composed earlier Fallout titles, but Zur is responsible for the main theme of the fourth installment.

questions.question: Who composed the original music for the 2015 game Undertale?
questions.explanation_correct: Toby Fox composed Undertale’s original soundtrack. Its music has also been performed in licensed orchestral concerts.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers are associated with different games; “Symphony of Souls” is not established here as an official Undertale album.

questions.question: Which composer created the tracks 'Melee Cafe' and 'Divinitus' for Total War: Rome?
questions.explanation_correct: Jeff van Dyck is the composer behind the memorable vocal and orchestral tracks of the original Total War: Rome.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers mentioned are notable for other franchises but did not compose these specific tracks.

questions.question: Who served as the lead composer for the orchestral jazz score of Grim Fandango?
questions.explanation_correct: Peter McConnell created the noir-inspired orchestral jazz score for this LucasArts adventure game.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While Land and Bajakian worked for LucasArts, McConnell was the primary lead for this specific score.

questions.question: Which composer created the melancholic orchestral score for Hollow Knight?
questions.explanation_correct: Christopher Larkin wrote the critically praised orchestral score that emphasizes the game's atmosphere.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others are well-known indie composers but did not work on this game.

questions.question: What is the Japanese title of the survival-horror series known internationally as Resident Evil?
questions.explanation_correct: Capcom’s Resident Evil series is known in Japan as Biohazard.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other titles are separate horror-game series.

questions.question: Who was the lead composer of the traditional Japanese-inspired score for Okami?
questions.explanation_correct: Hiroshi Yamaguchi was one of the composers of Ōkami, alongside Masami Ueda and other contributors.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The listed alternatives are not credited as composers of the original Ōkami score.

questions.question: Who was the primary composer of the cinematic orchestral score for the 2018 title Marvel's Spider-Man?
questions.explanation_correct: John Paesano composed the sweeping, cinematic orchestral score for the PS4 Spider-Man game.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other individuals listed are also famous composers but were not the primary score lead for this specific title.

questions.question: Which composer wrote the piece “Castle in the Mist” for Ico?
questions.explanation_correct: Michiru Ōshima is credited with “Castle in the Mist”; Ico’s soundtrack also includes work by Pentagon and other contributors.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The listed composers did not compose the specified piece.

questions.question: Who is the legendary composer widely recognized for the enduring 'Symphonic Suite' arrangements of the Dragon Quest series?
questions.explanation_correct: Koichi Sugiyama composed music for Dragon Quest, including material arranged and recorded in the Symphonic Suite albums.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers are associated with different game music; orchestral performance and arrangement credits can vary by album.

questions.question: Which composer wrote music for the original 1999 Medal of Honor game?
questions.explanation_correct: Michael Giacchino composed the original Medal of Honor score; he had also worked on earlier games.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other named film composers did not compose the original game’s score.

questions.question: Who composed the tracks included in the soundtrack for Lost Odyssey, such as 'Roar of the Departed Souls'?
questions.explanation_correct: Nobuo Uematsu provided the expansive, orchestral foundation for Lost Odyssey.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These composers are renowned for other orchestral RPG scores but were not the primary lead here.

questions.question: Who is responsible for the iconic gothic, orchestral score found in Castlevania: Symphony of the Night?
questions.explanation_correct: Michiru Yamane is credited with the elaborate, baroque-styled score for this Castlevania entry.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers are associated with NES-era platformers or different iconic game series.

questions.question: Who served as the lead composer for the vocal and orchestral score in NieR: Automata?
questions.explanation_correct: Keiichi Okabe led a team including other composers who contributed to NieR: Automata.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other names were not the lead composer of this title; Ryuichi Sakamoto was primarily known for music beyond games.

questions.question: Which composer was the project music director and lead composer on Overwatch?
questions.explanation_correct: Derek Duke led Overwatch music, with contributions from other composers including Neal Acree and Sam Cardon.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are composers associated with different projects.

questions.question: Which composer was responsible for the synth-orchestral fusion score found in Death Stranding?
questions.explanation_correct: Ludvig Forssell worked closely with Hideo Kojima to produce the unique soundscape of this project.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These composers focus on different musical styles or are attached to different cinematic game franchises.

questions.question: Who served as the original lead composer for the Guild Wars 2 soundtrack?
questions.explanation_correct: Jeremy Soule is well-known for his expansive work on this specific MMO franchise.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These contemporary composers have worked on other major series but were not the leads for the original Guild Wars 2 release.

questions.question: Which strategy game includes the 2010 campaign “Wings of Liberty”?
questions.explanation_correct: Wings of Liberty is the first StarCraft II campaign; its soundtrack was created by a team of composers and performers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other games are Blizzard titles but do not contain that campaign.

questions.question: Which composer crafted the noir-inspired, jazzy orchestral score for the game L.A. Noire?
questions.explanation_correct: Andrew Hale composed the score for L.A. Noire; Simon Hale contributed orchestration and arrangements.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other names are different musicians, though Simon Hale also worked on the project.

questions.question: Who composed and conducted the distinct, award-winning orchestral score for The Banner Saga?
questions.explanation_correct: Austin Wintory utilized a unique Scandinavian-influenced approach for the score of this tactical game.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Bear McCreary and Garry Schyman are composers; Todd Howard is a game director and producer.

questions.question: Who acted as the primary composer for the extensive soundtrack of Baldur's Gate 3?
questions.explanation_correct: Borislav Slavov provided the thematic orchestral depth for this massive role-playing game.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These artists are famous for fantasy RPG scores but were not involved in Baldur's Gate 3.

questions.question: Who composed the main theme for the 2009 game Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2?
questions.explanation_correct: Hans Zimmer is credited with the main theme; Lorne Balfe composed much of the game’s additional score.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other film and game composers did not compose the main theme identified here.

questions.question: Which composer was part of the Warcraft III music team alongside Derek Duke, Glenn Stafford, and Jason Hayes?
questions.explanation_correct: Tracy W. Bush was one of several composers credited on Warcraft III.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are composers associated with other projects.

questions.question: Who composed the original music for Secret of Mana?
questions.explanation_correct: Hiroki Kikuta composed the original Secret of Mana score for the Super Nintendo; later orchestral arrangements are separate productions.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The listed composers worked on other games, not the original Secret of Mana score.

questions.question: Which composer is famously associated with the creation of Guile's theme in Street Fighter II?
questions.explanation_correct: Yoko Shimomura composed much of Street Fighter II’s music, including Guile’s theme; the game’s music credits also include Isao Abe.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The listed alternatives are not credited with composing Guile’s theme.

questions.question: Who composed the dark, atmospheric orchestral score for the original Gears of War?
questions.explanation_correct: Kevin Riepl provided the gritty, brutalist orchestral score that defined the first entry of this cover-shooter.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These composers are associated with other high-octane action games or sci-fi shooters.

questions.question: Who composed the deeply unsettling and dissonant orchestral score for the original Dead Space?
questions.explanation_correct: Jason Graves used unconventional orchestral techniques to craft the horror-focused sound of Dead Space.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These artists are known for horror tropes or experimental music but were not the primary team on this game.

questions.question: Who is the legendary composer responsible for writing the iconic 'One-Winged Angel' track?
questions.explanation_correct: Nobuo Uematsu composed “One-Winged Angel” for Final Fantasy VII; the wider Final Fantasy series has featured multiple composers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others are prolific video game composers but did not write this specific track.

questions.question: Which Japanese musician composed the original main theme for the first installment of The Legend of Zelda?
questions.explanation_correct: Koji Kondo is the primary composer for Nintendo who created the distinct main themes for both Mario and Zelda franchises.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These composers are famous for other Japanese developed franchises but are not the original author of the Zelda theme.

questions.question: What is the official soundtrack title of the choral main theme from The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim?
questions.explanation_correct: The Skyrim original soundtrack lists the main choral theme as “Dragonborn,” composed by Jeremy Soule. “Sons of Skyrim” is a commonly used alternate label.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other titles do not identify the soundtrack’s “Dragonborn” track.

questions.question: Who is the orchestral composer for the 2018 action game God of War?
questions.explanation_correct: Bear McCreary provided the sweeping orchestral and Norse-influenced score for the 2018 reboot.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These composers are well-known in the industry but did not serve as the lead for this specific title.

questions.question: Whose Journey soundtrack became the first video game score nominated for the Grammy for Best Score Soundtrack for Visual Media?
questions.explanation_correct: Austin Wintory’s Journey received a nomination in that category; Christopher Tin’s “Baba Yetu” had previously won a Grammy for a song originally written for a game.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers did not receive the specific Journey nomination.

questions.question: Who composed the Gregorian-esque chant theme for Halo: Combat Evolved?
questions.explanation_correct: Martin O’Donnell composed the well-known Halo theme; Michael Salvatori also collaborated on music across the Halo franchise.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other named composers did not compose the specified theme.

questions.question: Which vocal track accompanies the fall of the Lich King in a Wrath of the Lich King cinematic?
questions.explanation_correct: “Invincible” is associated with Arthas and appears in the cinematic after the Lich King’s defeat.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options do not name the specified vocal track.

questions.question: At which London studio was orchestral music for Bloodborne recorded?
questions.explanation_correct: PlayStation describes Bloodborne’s recording as a collaboration involving AIR Studios in London, with multiple composers and performers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other studios are not the London studio named in the source.

questions.question: Who served as the composer for the cinematic, minimalist orchestral score found in Shadow of the Colossus?
questions.explanation_correct: Kow Otani created the sweeping yet sparse orchestral compositions that define the mood of the game.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These composers are giants in Japanese RPG music but did not score Shadow of the Colossus.

questions.question: What unique string instrument is primarily featured in the title track of The Last of Us?
questions.explanation_correct: Gustavo Santaolalla centers much of his composition for the series around the ronroco, a South American string instrument.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These are related string instruments from the same family but were not the primary focus of the theme.

questions.question: What was the name of the live orchestra formed specifically to record the music for Super Mario Galaxy?
questions.explanation_correct: The Mario Galaxy Orchestra is the credited ensemble for orchestral recordings in Super Mario Galaxy; Mahito Yokota and Koji Kondo were among its composers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are fictional names not associated with the official production of the game's soundtrack.

questions.question: Which composer was a member of HOYO-MiX and wrote music for the early Genshin Impact soundtrack?
questions.explanation_correct: Yu-Peng Chen composed music for early Genshin Impact as part of HOYO-MiX; the soundtrack also includes work by other composers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other names are composers associated with different projects.

questions.question: Which composer contributed to the soundtrack of Elden Ring and discussed its title theme in a PlayStation interview?
questions.explanation_correct: Tsukasa Saitoh contributed to the Elden Ring soundtrack and discussed its title theme in a PlayStation interview.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other listed composers are associated with other games.

questions.question: What is the title of the Swahili-language choral song that famously won a Grammy for Civilization IV?
questions.explanation_correct: Christopher Tin wrote “Baba Yetu” for Civilization IV. Its recording on Calling All Dawns won a Grammy; subsequent video-game music has also won Grammy Awards.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These are similar sounding but incorrect titles that do not match the award-winning composition.

questions.question: Which Hollywood composer was recruited to create the cinematic main theme for Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty?
questions.explanation_correct: Konami hired Harry Gregson-Williams to bring a sweeping, filmic quality to the series' second mainline entry.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These other composers are famous for Hollywood films but were not the ones hired for this project.

questions.question: The vocal elements in The Witcher 3's award-winning soundtrack are best categorized under which musical tradition?
questions.explanation_correct: The Witcher 3 soundtrack draws on several folk traditions, including Slavic and broader Eastern European instruments and vocal styles.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Musical influences can overlap; the listed alternatives do not name the principal tradition identified in this question.

questions.question: Who was the principal composer of the original Chrono Trigger soundtrack?
questions.explanation_correct: Yasunori Mitsuda wrote much of the original Chrono Trigger score; Nobuo Uematsu and Noriko Matsueda also contributed.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Uematsu contributed to the score, but Mitsuda was its principal composer.

questions.question: Which composer created the enduring piano-led melody titled 'Dearly Beloved' for Kingdom Hearts?
questions.explanation_correct: Yoko Shimomura is the prolific composer who wrote the evocative opening theme for the franchise.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These composers are associated with other Square Enix titles but did not compose this specific piece.

questions.question: What is the common name of the memorable, adventurous orchestral theme featured prominently throughout the Uncharted series?
questions.explanation_correct: “Nate’s Theme,” originally composed by Greg Edmonson, is a recurring musical theme of the Uncharted series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other titles do not identify the established theme.

questions.question: What song written and performed by Paul McCartney was featured in Destiny?
questions.explanation_correct: Paul McCartney’s “Hope for the Future” was written for Destiny and released as a single; Giles Martin produced the recording.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other titles do not name McCartney’s Destiny song.

questions.question: Who served as the primary composer for the atmospheric score of Silent Hill 2?
questions.explanation_correct: Akira Yamaoka is renowned for composing the audio-visual soundscape of the Silent Hill series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers are known for work on series like No More Heroes, Persona, and Castlevania.

questions.question: Which composer was responsible for the 'Ludwig, the Holy Blade' theme in Bloodborne?
questions.explanation_correct: Nobuyoshi Suzuki is credited with “Ludwig, the Holy Blade” from Bloodborne: The Old Hunters.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Saitoh, Kitamura and Amon also contributed to Bloodborne music, but the specified track is credited to Suzuki.

questions.question: What is the title of the recurring iconic theme song that appears across the Monster Hunter franchise?
questions.explanation_correct: Proof of a Hero is the signature, triumphant melody that plays during the final stages of many flagship hunts.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are fictional titles that do not correspond to established series music.

questions.question: Who composed the critically acclaimed orchestral track 'Moonlit Wilderness' for the Tekken series?
questions.explanation_correct: Satoru Kosaki is the credited composer for this iconic stage theme from Tekken 5.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are fellow composers at Namco who have contributed to the series' extensive history.

questions.question: Which composer created the sweeping, heroic track 'Daredevil' for Ace Combat 7?
questions.explanation_correct: Keiki Kobayashi is the lead musician who defined the grand, orchestral sound of the later Ace Combat series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others are sound designers or composers who have provided different styles to various Namco rhythm and flight titles.

questions.question: Which artist provided the vocals for the theme song 'Still Alive' in Mirror's Edge?
questions.explanation_correct: Swedish singer-songwriter Lisa Miskovsky provided the vocals for the lead marketing song.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other performers are not the singer credited on “Still Alive”; Ane Brun is Norwegian, not Swedish.

questions.question: Which composer was music director on Diablo III and contributed to its score?
questions.explanation_correct: Russell Brower was Blizzard’s audio director and contributed music to Diablo III with other composers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers are associated with other games.

questions.question: Which vocalist performed the distinct lead vocals on the boss theme for Blue Dragon?
questions.explanation_correct: The Deep Purple lead vocalist provided the powerful vocal performance for the game's high-energy boss music.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others are legendary hard rock vocalists of similar stature but were not featured in this production.

questions.question: Which of the following composers contributed to the score of God of War III?
questions.explanation_correct: Gerard Marino contributed to God of War III with several other composers, including Cris Velasco, Jeff Rona and Mike Reagan.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are associated with different games; the God of War III score had multiple contributors.

questions.question: Who composed “In the Blood” for Hades, featuring vocals by Ashley Barrett?
questions.explanation_correct: Darren Korb composed “In the Blood”; the recording features Ashley Barrett alongside Korb.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers did not write the specified song.

questions.question: Who is the primary composer responsible for the seafaring, nautical score of Sea of Thieves?
questions.explanation_correct: Robin Beanland contributed music to Sea of Thieves alongside other collaborators; the soundtrack includes a variety of maritime styles.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The listed alternatives are composers, but not the specific contributor named here.

questions.question: Which composer joined the Xenoblade series beginning with Xenoblade Chronicles X to bring a signature hybrid orchestral and electronic style?
questions.explanation_correct: Hiroyuki Sawano is the composer for Xenoblade Chronicles X, known for his cinematic and 'epic' orchestral style.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others have worked on Monolith Soft projects or classic JRPGs but do not share Sawano's specific style for the X entry.

questions.question: Who composed the orchestral jazz score featured in Gravity Rush?
questions.explanation_correct: Kohei Tanaka provided the adventurous, jazzy orchestral arrangements for this series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others are well-known composers of JRPG soundtracks that typically feature different tonal characteristics.

questions.question: Who served as the primary composer for the early orchestral aesthetic of the Ratchet & Clank series?
questions.explanation_correct: David Bergeaud composed music for the early Ratchet & Clank games; their scores are not uniformly orchestral.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The listed composers are not credited as the primary composer of the original 2002 score.

questions.question: Which composer created the moody, cello-heavy musical score for A Plague Tale?
questions.explanation_correct: Olivier Derivière focused on the raw, distressed emotive quality of string instruments to define the game's atmosphere.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The alternative options compose for major RPGs or cinematic titles with distinct focuses on symphonic scales.

questions.question: Which pair composed music for the original Kingdom Come: Deliverance?
questions.explanation_correct: Jan Valta and Adam Sporka collaborated on the score for Kingdom Come: Deliverance.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other pairs did not compose the original game’s score.

questions.question: Who was the composer behind the lounge-inspired orchestral score of SimCity 4?
questions.explanation_correct: Jerry Martin created the smooth, relaxing orchestral jazz fusion that defines the SimCity franchise's identity.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These candidates either work in contemporary film or are known for different rhythmic styles.

questions.question: Which composer provided the historical, period-grounded orchestral score for Age of Empires IV?
questions.explanation_correct: Tilman Sillescu contributed to the Age of Empires IV score as part of a broader music team.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other composers are associated with other projects or earlier franchise entries.

questions.question: Who composed the iconic, percussion-driven opening theme for Crysis 2?
questions.explanation_correct: Hans Zimmer brought his signature blockbuster orchestral Hollywood sound to the main theme of this title.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These are all composers known for action-film scores but did not lead the musical direction here.

questions.question: Who composed the iconic, synth-augmented orchestral score for Deus Ex: Human Revolution?
questions.explanation_correct: Michael McCann implemented the 'cyber-renaissance' sound, blending orchestral elements with modern digital synthesis.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The listed names are notable electronic or industrial composers who provided different sound directions for cyberpunk games.

questions.question: Which pair is credited with music for the original Dota 2 trailer?
questions.explanation_correct: Valve’s published trailer score credits both Jason Hayes and Tim Larkin.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other pairs did not receive the trailer credit.

questions.question: Who is the original composer recognized for scoring the Metroid Prime series?
questions.explanation_correct: Kenji Yamamoto contributed to the original Metroid Prime score together with Kouichi Kyuma; the series has multiple music contributors.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are associated with other Nintendo music projects.

questions.question: Which renowned musician composed the main theme for the original Fable?
questions.explanation_correct: Danny Elfman composed the main theme that introduces the magical world of the original Fable.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Russell Shaw composed the bulk of the score, but the specific main theme credit goes to Elfman.

questions.question: Who composed the moody, noir-inspired orchestral score for Heavy Rain?
questions.explanation_correct: Normand Corbeil was the primary composer for the somber and emotional score of Heavy Rain.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These other composers specialize in film/game scores but were not responsible for this specific title.

questions.question: Who served as the lead composer for Total War: Shogun 2?
questions.explanation_correct: Jeff van Dyck created the distinct soundscape for Total War: Shogun 2.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others are prolific game composers, but they did not lead the score for this particular strategy game.

questions.question: Who composed music for the action RPG Grim Dawn?
questions.explanation_correct: Steve Pardo contributed music to Grim Dawn; the game’s audio production includes multiple contributors.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are composers associated with other games.

questions.question: Which composer provided the cinematic, industrial-infused score for Wolfenstein: The New Order?
questions.explanation_correct: Mick Gordon composed music for Wolfenstein: The New Order; Fredrik Thordendal also contributed additional music. Martin Stig Andersen later worked on Wolfenstein II.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are composers associated with different games.

questions.question: What is the title of the recurring opening theme associated with the Gran Turismo franchise?
questions.explanation_correct: Moon Over The Castle is the long-running signature theme for the series, originating from Masahiro Andoh.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are generic titles that mimic the naming convention but were not official themes.

questions.question: Which composer worked with Kenneth Young on the interactive “Gardens” music in LittleBigPlanet?
questions.explanation_correct: Mat Clark and Kenneth Young are credited with the interactive Gardens music in LittleBigPlanet.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other listed composers are not the collaborator specified.

questions.question: Who composed the unique banjo-orchestral score featured in Outer Wilds?
questions.explanation_correct: Andrew Prahlow received acclaim for blending Americana instrumentation with orchestral space arrangements in Outer Wilds.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These other composers are known for indie game hits, but none led the music for this space exploration title.

questions.question: Which pair is credited with the Dishonored end-credits song “Honor for All”?
questions.explanation_correct: Daniel Licht and Jon Licht collaborated on “Honor for All,” the song heard in the end credits of Dishonored.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other pairs did not create the specified track.

questions.question: Which individual served as the lead composer for the space-themed soundtrack of Stellaris?
questions.explanation_correct: Andreas Waldetoft is the lead composer responsible for the orchestral score of the Stellaris universe.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These are prominent strategy game or sci-fi composers who focused on other intellectual properties.

questions.question: Who is the composer behind the melancholic, string-heavy score for Frostpunk?
questions.explanation_correct: Piotr Musial created the haunting, desperate orchestral themes that underscore the survival aspect of Frostpunk.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are Polish game composers but are not credited as the composer of the original Frostpunk score.

questions.question: Which composer provided the survival-oriented, nervous orchestral score for the Tomb Raider reboot in 2013?
questions.explanation_correct: Jason Graves utilized custom instruments to create the gritty, tense atmosphere of the 2013 reboot.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Nathan McCree composed for earlier Tomb Raider titles; Jim Bonney contributed additional music to the 2013 game alongside Jason Graves.

questions.question: What primary musical style defines the core soundtrack of Grim Fandango?
questions.explanation_correct: The score to Grim Fandango is heavily inspired by 1940s jazz, swing, and traditional Latin music styles.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The game's period and setting require a historical noir-adjacent sound rather than modern genres.

questions.question: What is the title of the main theme that introduces The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind?
questions.explanation_correct: “Nerevar Rising” is the opening theme of Morrowind, composed by Jeremy Soule; the Elder Scrolls series had earlier music before this game.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other titles do not identify Morrowind’s opening track.

questions.question: Which composer is credited with the SNES orchestral-simulation style of the original Star Fox?
questions.explanation_correct: Hajime Hirasawa arranged the distinct chip-tune orchestral themes for the original Star Fox.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These composers are legends in gaming but did not handle this specific Nintendo project.

questions.question: Which composer contributed music to the original SoulCalibur soundtrack?
questions.explanation_correct: Junichi Nakatsuru was one of the composers credited on SoulCalibur; the soundtrack was a collaborative project.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other choices are composers associated with different game series.

questions.question: Which composer is responsible for the whimsical and melodic score of Banjo-Kazooie?
questions.explanation_correct: Grant Kirkhope created the playful, lighthearted score that became a staple of the Banjo-Kazooie franchise.
questions.explanation_incorrect: David Wise and Robin Beanland are also iconic Rare composers, but they were not the lead on this title.

questions.question: Which composer contributed to the Fire Emblem: Awakening soundtrack alongside Rei Kondoh?
questions.explanation_correct: Hiroki Morishita and Rei Kondoh are among the composers credited on Fire Emblem: Awakening.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are composers associated with different projects.
